name: Engineering Status
summary: A public status page: regions banner, 90-day uptime strips per service, active incidents with update timelines, and a fortnight of incident history.
useWhen: You need a public, signed-out status page for a platform
Services, uptime history and incident updates should read at a glance
avoidWhen: You need an in-app health widget; use a compact status card
You need live probes or subscriptions; this renders data you pass in
